meta.name: vibe-workflow
meta.description: Complete 5-step workflow to build an MVP from idea to launch. Use when the user wants to start a new project from scratch, go through the full workflow, or says "help me build an MVP", "start new project", or "vibe coding workflow".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从零到发布，五步构建你的MVP
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果有一个想法想快速变成可用的产品
copy.tagline_en: Build your MVP from idea to launch in 5 steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have an idea and want to turn it into a working product quickly

howto.what: 引导你完成从想法到上线 MVP 的 5 个步骤：调研、写需求文档、技术设计、生成 AI 配置、构建产品。它会检查项目进度，告诉你下一步该做什么。
howto.when: 当你开始一个新项目，或说出“帮我构建 MVP”、“开始新项目”、“vibe coding workflow”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 我想做一个记账 App，帮我开始调研。
调研已经做完了，下一步该做什么？
say.note: 检查进度并引导到 PRD 步骤。

say.text: 直接跳到构建阶段，跳过技术设计。
say.note: 会提醒你跳过步骤的风险，但尊重你的选择。

howto.what_en: Guides you through a 5-step workflow to build an MVP from idea to launch: Research, PRD, Tech Design, Agent Config, and Build. It checks project progress and tells you the next step.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you start a new project, or say "help me build an MVP", "start new project", or "vibe coding workflow".

say_en.text: I want to build a budgeting app, help me start research.

say_en.note: Checks progress and guides to PRD step.

say_en.text: Skip to build phase, ignore tech design.
say_en.note: Warns about skipping risks but respects your choice.
